query:
-- Buscar Lucas na tabela users (login OAuth)
SELECT id, open_id AS openId, name, email, role, created_at, last_signed_in
FROM users
WHERE name LIKE '%Lucas%' OR email LIKE '%limir%' OR email LIKE '%lucas%'
ORDER BY id;
